name: Tersis Technologies Inc.
summary: Tersis Technologies Inc. operates as a pioneering environmental solutions provider, specializing in the development of comprehensive systems. These initiatives span critical areas including sustainable energy generation, hydrogen fuel production, carbon capture and utilization, soil health restoration, water resource security, and the advancement of a circular economy. Established in 2002 and headquartered in Circleville, Ohio, the company is presently known as International Consolidated Companies, Inc., but is slated to officially adopt the Tersis Technologies Inc. name in September 2025.
